lessons.content:
## Describe → AI First Pass → You Refine → Level Up

Every AI skill in finance follows the same loop:

1. **Describe** — Tell AI what you need in plain language
2. **AI First Pass** — Get a draft, analysis, or output in seconds
3. **You Refine** — Apply your expertise, judgment, and context
4. **Level Up** — Turn the one-off into a reusable agent, tool, or template

This pattern works across all five core skills. The only thing that changes is *what* you're describing.

### The 5 Skills

| # | Skill | What It Means |
|---|-------|--------------|
| 1 | **Gain Knowledge** | AI as your research partner |
| 2 | **Communicate** | AI eliminates writer's block |
| 3 | **Analyze & Validate** | AI as your tireless second set of eyes |
| 4 | **Improve Processes** | AI redesigns workflows at three levels |
| 5 | **Build Tools** | AI builds deployed apps in minutes |

Master all five and you've fundamentally changed how you work. Not someday — today.

> **The key insight:** You don't need to learn five different things. You need to learn one pattern and apply it five different ways.
lessons.title: The Universal Pattern

lessons.content:
## AI as Your Research Partner, Not a Search Engine

The mistake most people make: they ask AI one question and move on. That's using it as Google.

### The Right Way: Have a Conversation

Don't ask one question — ask five follow-ups. That's where real understanding lives.

**Example — Learning about ASC 842 lease accounting changes:**

❌ Bad: *"What is ASC 842?"*
→ You get a Wikipedia-level answer.

✅ Good:
1. *"What is ASC 842 and how does it differ from ASC 840?"*
2. *"What are the most common implementation mistakes companies make?"*
3. *"How does this affect our balance sheet ratios that banks look at for covenants?"*
4. *"Give me a checklist for reviewing whether our existing leases are properly classified"*
5. *"Now write me a 1-page briefing for my CFO on what we need to do this quarter"*

Five questions. Five minutes. You went from "I should learn about this" to "I have a briefing ready for my boss."

### The Skill Is Knowing How to Keep Drilling

- **First question** = surface-level understanding
- **Second question** = clarification and nuance
- **Third question** = application to your specific context
- **Fourth question** = reusable output (checklist, template)
- **Fifth question** = communication artifact (memo, briefing)

> **Level up:** Save your best question chains as templates. Share them with your team. Build them into an agent's skills.

📎 [Module 1: Using AI to Gain Knowledge](https://finney.finance/program/module-1-using-ai-to-gain-knowledge-find-information)

lessons.content:
## AI Eliminates Writer's Block

Blank page to solid draft in 30 seconds. That's not an exaggeration — it's the daily reality for finance professionals using AI.

### The Formula

Give AI three things:
1. **Context** — what this is about, who it's for
2. **Tone** — formal, casual, urgent, diplomatic
3. **Key points** — the 3-5 things that must be in there

Then edit to sound like you.

### Real Finance Examples

**Board summary:**
> *"Write a 3-paragraph board summary for May. Revenue was $2.1M (5% above plan). COGS came in high due to a one-time vendor charge. We're maintaining full-year guidance. Tone: confident but measured."*

**Vendor negotiation email:**
> *"Draft an email to our software vendor. Our contract renews in 60 days. We want to negotiate a 15% reduction based on lower usage. Tone: professional, firm but fair."*

**Team update on new process:**
> *"Write a Slack message to the accounting team explaining we're switching from manual JE review to an AI-assisted checklist. Tone: enthusiastic but acknowledging the learning curve."*

### The Multiplier

| Task | Without AI | With AI |
|------|-----------|---------|
| Board summary | 45 min | 5 min |
| Vendor email | 20 min | 3 min |
| Team announcement | 15 min | 2 min |
| Variance commentary (10 lines) | 30 min | 5 min |

> **Level up:** Build a "communications agent" with your company's tone guide, templates, and preferences loaded as context. Never start from scratch again.

📎 [Module 2: Using AI to Communicate](https://finney.finance/program/module-2-using-ai-to-communicate)
lessons.title: Skill 2: Communicate

lessons.content:
## The Tireless Second Set of Eyes

AI never gets fatigued. It doesn't rush through the last 20 JEs because it's Friday at 4pm. It checks everything with the same rigor.

### How to Use It

**Step 1: Paste the data**
Give AI the journal entry, the reconciliation, the financial statement — whatever needs review.

**Step 2: Ask for validation**
> *"Does this journal entry balance? Are the account codes valid per our chart of accounts? Is the amount consistent with historical entries for this type of transaction?"*

**Step 3: Ask for a reusable checklist**
> *"Based on the issues you found, create a validation checklist I can use for all future entries of this type."*

### One Review Becomes a Process

This is where the "Level Up" part of the pattern kicks in:

| Stage | What Happens |
|-------|-------------|
| **One-off** | You paste a JE, AI reviews it |
| **Template** | You save the prompt as a reusable template |
| **Checklist** | AI generates a validation checklist from patterns |
| **Agent** | You build an agent that reviews every JE automatically |

### What AI Catches That Humans Miss
- Duplicate entries across periods
- Account codes that don't match the description
- Amounts that are statistical outliers
- Missing required fields or approvals
- Inconsistencies between related entries

> **The skill isn't asking AI to check your work. The skill is asking AI to build the system that checks all work, forever.**

📎 [Module 3: Using AI to Analyze & Validate](https://finney.finance/program/module-3-using-ai-to-analyze-review-validate)
lessons.title: Skill 3: Analyze & Validate

lessons.content:
## Three Levels of Process Improvement

Most people stop at Level 1. The real value is in Levels 2 and 3.

### Level 1: AI Does the Work for You (This Time)
You have a task. You ask AI to do it. It's done faster.
- *"Write the variance commentary for these 10 line items"*
- *"Categorize these 200 transactions"*
- *"Match these two lists and find the exceptions"*

**Result:** Time saved on this instance. You still do it manually next month.

### Level 2: AI Builds a Reusable Tool
You ask AI to build something you can use again and again.
- *"Build me a template that auto-generates variance commentary from a budget-vs-actual table"*
- *"Create a categorization engine I can paste transactions into every month"*
- *"Build a reconciliation tool that matches and highlights exceptions"*

**Result:** Permanent time savings. The tool exists forever.

### Level 3: AI Redesigns the Process
You ask AI to rethink the entire workflow.
- *"Why do we even have this manual step? What if the data flowed directly from source to output?"*
- *"Redesign this 8-step reconciliation into a 3-step automated workflow"*
- *"What if we eliminated this report entirely and replaced it with a real-time dashboard?"*

**Result:** The step isn't needed at all. The best improvement is removing the step.

> **The best process improvement is deleting the process.**

📎 [Module 4: Using AI to Improve Manual Tasks](https://finney.finance/program/module-4-using-ai-to-improve-manual-tasks)
lessons.title: Skill 4: Improve Processes

lessons.content:
## Describe What You Need — AI Builds It

This is the skill that changes everything. When you can build tools, you stop waiting for IT, stop paying for software you don't need, and start solving your own problems.

### The Platforms

| Platform | Best For | Time to Deploy |
|----------|----------|---------------|
| **Claude Artifacts** | Quick visual tools, calculators, trackers | 60 seconds |
| **Google Apps Script** | Anything connected to Google Sheets | 5 minutes |
| **Claude Code** | Full applications, multi-file projects | 15 minutes |

### What Finance Pros Are Building

- Expense dashboards that pull live data from Sheets
- Close trackers with status toggles and progress bars
- Reconciliation tools that auto-match transactions
- Compliance training games (RPG-style SOX training)
- Budget variance reports that generate themselves
- Allocation engines with built-in balance controls

### The Speed Gap

AI builds tools in **60 seconds** that would take IT **6 months** to prioritize, scope, build, and deploy.

That's not an efficiency gain. That's a category change. You're no longer a "requestor" waiting in a queue. You're a builder.

### Go Try It Right Now

Open Claude and type one of these:
- *"Build me a PO approval tracker"*
- *"Build me a currency conversion calculator for month-end"*
- *"Build me an intercompany elimination worksheet"*

You'll have a working tool before you finish reading this sentence.

> **AI builds tools in 60 seconds that would take IT 6 months.**

📎 [Ore Phillips Guides](https://finney.finance/project/ore-phillips-guides)
